description: Single automated match test. Events are logged by server/clients and scraped from logs. Events with an 'action' block are executed by the MockPlayer bot on the matching client.

events.description: Dedicated server starts and listens on port 8910
Client A connects to the server
Client B connects to the server
Game starts (World scene loads on both clients)
Server spawns armies from the active map config (S/L/XL)
Player A selects its first army
Player A sends its first army to the Stables capture point
Player B selects its first army
Player B sends its first army to the Blacksmith capture point
Once A controls Stables, Player A flips all its armies from defensive to aggressive
Once B controls Blacksmith, Player B flips all its armies from defensive to aggressive
Game ends because only one player has any armies left (or the 120s match timeout fires as a safety net)

other_tests.description_of_test: Match did not finish via timeout safety net (TEST_GAME_OVER_TIMEOUT must NOT appear — its presence means combat failed to resolve within 120s)
Clients never hard-snapped a unit (TEST_SIM_CLIENT snaps= must stay 0 after spawn; a non-zero value means prediction and server diverged by > 60 units, the old teleport symptom)
Clients never animated a unit as walking without displacement (TEST_SIM_CLIENT walk_in_place= must stay 0)
SpatialHash: counting-sort grid radius/nearest queries match brute force on 3000 random points, and a 2000-unit rebuild + queries stay within budget

UnitSim: formation move arrives with monotonic distance-to-goal, flags track displacement, combat kills and routs, 2000-unit step budget, no NaN/off-map positions; NetSync 8-byte snapshot pack/unpack round-trips
Headless server match: World as offline authority with two fake players, all armies aggressive, sim driven at 60 Hz until someone routs and a winner is announced (combat must not stall)
Headless texture paths: red/blue spearman PNGs load as ImageTexture (same path logic as UnitRenderer)
Headless 3D client spawn path: instantiating World.tscn and calling _client_spawn_armies_impl produces the expected unit count

Headless formation move: a move order applied through the order echo path drives every soldier of a 12-man army to its slot (within 3 units), with no distance-to-goal back-jumps after arrival (A->B->A regression) and no moving flag without displacement (walking-in-place regression)
Terrain feature types: hill, ridge, spline_ridge, plateau raise height; valley carves; heights stay >= 0
Terrain raycast matches MapConfig.sample_height on hill sample points (delta < 0.5)
Headless client spawn: horse armies receive the mounted sim speed and F_HORSE flag
XL map bounds: peak height probe and far-corner ground raycast succeed
XL max zoom: hold W until north map edge reaches viewport (visible ground min_z <= 40)
XL auto-detected lakes: terrain basins spawn water planes with lakes_water.png
Lake polygon mesh: L-shaped mask boundary traces, expands, and triangulates
Lake basin filter: reject interior high ground (donut); clip cells above water surface
XL per-map lighting: directional shadow distance scales with terrain; ground uses PER_PIXEL shading
XL walkability: water and steep slopes blocked; A* paths avoid lakes; steep_hills ground shader
XL vegetation: ~30 decorative trees/spruce/bushes on walkable terrain

ad_hoc_tests.description_of_test: Sprite facing: a sim unit walking right must set F_FACING_RIGHT, walking left must clear it, and the facing must persist while idle (the renderer turns this flag into the billboard flip). Not run by verify_test_logs.sh; invoke manually when you suspect the soldier sprites are not mirroring.
